definitions.explanation: Being assigned to one job or position only, as opposed to holding it alongside other duties. Common in job titles at schools, companies, and government offices.

examples.japanese: {専任|せんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧がいる。
examples.english: There is a full-time person in charge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専任|せんにん}⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧として⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: She works as a full-time lecturer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専任|せんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This department has three staff members dedicated to it full-time.

notes:
{専任|せんにん} pairs {専|せん} (exclusive) with {任|にん} (duty); it describes a person or post dedicated to one job only.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専任|せんにん}⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: full-time lecturer
- {専任|せんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: dedicated person in charge
- {専任|せんにん}⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧: full-time teacher

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {兼任|けんにん}: holding a post concurrently with another — the opposite of {専任|せんにん}
- ⟦{非常勤|ひじょうきん}→非常勤：10675_hijoukin⟧: part-time, non-regular staff
